description: Podcasts from Apple Podcasts search, top charts (any country and genre) or links, enriched from each show's RSS feed: owner name and contact email, website, language, categories, episode count, how often it posts and the last episode date; optionally the latest episodes with audio and transcript links. Use for guest booking, sponsorship outreach and podcast research. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/podcasts on your Apify account (about $0.004 per podcast; $0.001 per episode; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

active_within_days.description: Only shows with an episode in the last N days.

country.description: Store country for search and charts, e.g. us, gb, in.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

include_episodes.description: Add the latest episodes of each podcast.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

podcasts.description: Apple Podcasts links or ids, or RSS feed links.

with_email_only.description: Only shows whose feed lists an owner email.

name: search_podcasts

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search podcasts and charts (Apple Podcasts)
